title: Design: Part lookup results look as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A, with stock in one bin.
  • Have a Part Library entry, part B, that is not stocked at the test location, so the lookup lists one result from the Part Library.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Create an open work order for this test, work order 1, with one line.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 6.1 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Click work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part in the Parts row of its line.
  3. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Part Number box.
  4. Click the X at the top right of the New Part Request window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The New Part Request window opens with the Part Number box focused.

Step 3:

  • Part A's result shows its description at the left and its part number at the right on the first line, then "Inventory Qty:" with its quantity in grey, then an outlined chip with its bin and quantity.
  • Part B's result shows its description and part number on the first line, then "Part Library" in grey on its second line.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and the line's Parts row still shows only Add Part: no part was added.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library), story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S12-R10: “A part lookup result that comes from the shared list shows its source as "Part Library".”
  • S9-R1: “Part lookup on a work order line does not return inactive parts.”
